# Orlando Pool Leak Detection

> Pool leak detection and repair for Orlando, Winter Park, Lake Nona, Windermere, Oviedo, and Kissimmee, Florida. Homeowners call when a pool is losing water faster than evaporation and they want the leak found and fixed without guesswork. Phone: (321) 430-2495.

## Services

- [Pool Leak Detection](https://poolleakdetectionorlando.com/pool-leak-detection-orlando): Pressure testing, dye testing, and listening equipment to pinpoint where a pool is losing water.
- [Pool Leak Repair](https://poolleakdetectionorlando.com/pool-leak-repair): Repairs matched to what detection finds — structural cracks, fittings, seals, and plumbing lines.
- [Pool Plumbing Leak Detection](https://poolleakdetectionorlando.com/pool-plumbing-leak-detection): Line-by-line pressure testing to isolate underground plumbing leaks before anyone cuts into a deck.
- [Pool Skimmer Leak](https://poolleakdetectionorlando.com/pool-skimmer-leak): Confirming and repairing leaks at the skimmer throat and body — one of Central Florida's most common leak points.
- [Pool Light Leak](https://poolleakdetectionorlando.com/pool-light-leak): Finding and sealing leaks at pool light niches and conduit runs.
